page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.36xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 144 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The underlying hardware is driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a baseline frequency of 3.4 GHz.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.67 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

Given its high core count and relatively low memory-to-CPU ratio, this instance offers high compute density. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for highly parallelized, CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive per-core memory footprints or local storage. Suitable workloads include high-performance computing, intensive batch processing, web serving at scale, and parallelized compilation tasks.
